Title: Activate a worker who has a pending shop change request using valid OTP and matching PIN
Section: Worker Management - Worker Activation with Shop Change
Preconditions: 1. A worker with email 'worker@example.com' exists in the system but is not yet activated. 2. A pending shop change request exists for this worker, initiated by the current authenticated shop owner (username 'owner1'). 3. A valid OTP has been generated and sent to the worker's email.
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/shops/1/workers/activate with the payload in testData. 2. Verify the response status and body.

Test Data: {
  "phoneNumber": "worker@example.com",
  "otp": "123456",
  "pin": "1234",
  "confirmPin": "1234"
}

Title: Verify that OTP generation for worker activation is rejected if the requesting user has no pending shop change request
Section: Worker Management - OTP Generation and Verification
Preconditions: User is authenticated as a shop owner with no pending shop change requests. A valid worker email and role are available for testing.
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 204 (No Content) or 403 (Forbidden) and no OTP is sent to the worker's email.

Title: Verify that worker activation (PIN setting) enforces proper authorization - only users with pending shop change requests can activate workers for the target shop
Preconditions: User is authenticated as a shop owner with no pending shop change requests. A valid worker phone number, OTP, and PIN are available for testing.
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/shops/{shopId}/workers/activate with the payload in testData. Use a valid shopId where the user is the owner but has no pending shop change requests.

Test Data: {
  "phoneNumber": "+1234567890",
  "otp": "123456",
  "pin": "1234",
  "confirmPin": "1234"
}
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 403 (Forbidden) and a response body containing 'status: error', 'message: You do not have permission to modify this shop'. The worker's PIN is not set.

Title: Verify that worker activation (PIN setting) updates the worker's shop if a pending shop change request exists for the authenticated user
Preconditions: User is authenticated as a shop owner with a pending shop change request for the target shop. A valid worker phone number, OTP, and PIN are available for testing.
Steps:

Test Data: {
  "phoneNumber": "+1234567890",
  "otp": "123456",
  "pin": "1234",
  "confirmPin": "1234"
}
Expected Result: The API responds with HTTP status 201 (Created) and a response body containing 'status: success', 'message: Workers activated'. The worker's shop ID is updated to the target shop, and the pending shop change request is marked as completed.
